title: Liria 04 – A Garden for Tomorrow
summary: Between two old houses lay a small square that the residents had long since given up on. Weeds grew between the paving stones, and a broken bench stood against a weathered wall.
story:
Between two old houses lay a small square that the residents had long since given up on. Weeds grew between the paving stones, and a broken bench stood against a weathered wall.

As Liria passed, she noticed a girl trying to break up the hard earth with a little shovel.

"What are you doing there?" Liria asked curiously.

"Making a flower garden," the girl replied with determination.

Liria looked across the dusty square. "Quite a large one, too!"

"Everyone says nothing will grow here."

"And what do you say?"

The girl held up a small plant. "That we should try."

Liria smiled. "Then I suppose we'll need a second shovel!"

They spent the afternoon clearing stones, spreading fresh soil, and planting the first flowers.

An elderly neighbor brought water. A merchant donated more seedlings. Eventually, even some of the neighborhood children joined in.

As the sun slowly disappeared behind the rooftops, the girl proudly admired the little green plants.

"Do you think this will really become a garden?"

Liria knelt beside her.

"I think it already is one."

The next morning, a handwritten sign stood beside the flowerbed:

Our garden. Everyone is welcome to help.

Liria spotted it on her walk and couldn't help smiling.

Sometimes a great change began with a single tiny plant.
